notes.title: Update Note. 2022/07/27
notes.content:
Update Note. 2022/07/27

We would like to thank everyone who plays and cares about the Early Access level of Air Wars.

Today, the following changes have been made to 'Air Wars' monthly regular updates.

The main changes were the new UI based on the PC version, and functions such as mission info and radar map addition were applied.

Please deliver all feedback about the game through the Steam community and the Discord channel.

Discord Server:
https://discord.gg/T4768Yd6nr


Key Changes
[PC]
- Apply new UI
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39244168/bb452c1f6e06475b5e91bcfd0abb9a0bc3d9d454.png
At the start of the mission, the name of the mission and information about the aircraft being operated are displayed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39244168/bae40e4cea394360b581a962f953d93eda4a459d.png
A 'DESTROY' message is printed when the enemy is shot down after firing missiles and machine guns.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39244168/58d2c0d2730904ca6fde160299f5724c30b1e38a.png
A 'MISS' message is printed when the enemy is not shot down after the missile launch.

- Change UI during game
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39244168/c2b2711a3e1b7fc4751c904bcadf3bb07c2ea091.png
ⓐTop left - Description of mission objectives, time remaining, next target
ⓑBottom Left - Radar Map/Full Map (M) switching added
ⓒBottom right - Show remaining missile count, machine gun, fuel and throttle levels


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39244168/4188d68e3ba08048b531b3a52632365336d6d3b6.png
If the mission is successful, the level of the mission is determined based on the performance. Displays information about the enemy plane that was shot down


*We are planning to update to VR versions later.

notes.title: Update Note. 2022/05/25
notes.content:
A big thank you to everyone who's been playing and interested in Air Wars in Early Access.

Today, the following changes have been made to the monthly regular update history of Air Wars.

The major changes were the addition of devices supported by the DLC. And there have been some small improvements to the keyboard controls.

Please provide all feedback about the game through the Steam community and Discord channels.

Discord Server:
https://discord.gg/T4768Yd6nr


Major changes
[DLC]
- Added support for HOTAS equipment.
*Only Thrustmaster HOTAS WARTHOG™ is supported.

- Added support for RUDDER equipment.
* Only Thrustmaster TFRP RUDDER Pedal is supported.

- When running in VR, if you select the keyboard icon in the options, you can use HOTAS, RUDDER, and the keyboard even when wearing VR.

[PC]
- Some operability of keyboard operation has been improved.
- Fixed the issue that the throttle output returned to 50 when switching to another program window while operating the keyboard.

notes.title: Update Note. 2021/09/08
notes.content:
Update Note. 2021/09/08

We would like to thank everyone for playing and interested in Air Wars in the Early Access.

Today, the monthly updates of Air Wars have been changed to the following. 

The main change is to support the head tracking function through Track ir, and since it is a game based on the history of actual dogfights, we have added a little more realistic situation.

We hope to deliver all feedback on the game through the Steam community and the Discord channel.

Discord Server:
https://discord.gg/WQyJ4vfS6h

Major changes
- Added head tracking function through Track ir
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39244168/8e8fcd375f5fcfacff0545cc382241a99d6b765e.png

Changes made for immersion in real situations

- Removed missile reload system for all fighters
> The number of missiles available to fighters in each mission has been limited. This allows for careful missile use and has been tweaked to make it more immersive.

- Improved gun firing
> The machine gun, which was rarely used due to the limited number of missiles, was improved. When the selected target's range is within 800 meters, the machine gun's striking point appears.
Improvements have been made so that you can shoot more accurately.

- Fix other improvements
> Fixed the part where the missile warning sound was not applied to SFX
> Added fuel level display for fighter jets
> Added display of difficulty level for each mission
> Change the gun firing button: left click
> Change missile launch button: space bar
> Added view reset button: click mouse wheel
> Key guide changes due to some button fixes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39244168/2549ba3f06b5905a01f8c4a19d613f158b81daaa.png

notes.title: Update Note. 2021/03/31
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39244168/0c2af55c7959c8ee02fd8a1f93334b3ca2333d08.png

Thank you to everyone who plays AIRWARS VR in the early access stage.
AIRWARS has been updated so that it can be played without VR, so many players can enjoy the game.

Therefore, we will inform you that the name of the game has also been changed to AIRWARS.
When running the game, it is possible to run on PC or VR version as an option.

Please give us a lot of feedback about our game through the Steam community.

PC version features

You can control an aircraft with a keyboard.
 Option - added a key guide button that you can know how to operate. 
 First-person camera zoom-in and zoom-out functions have been added.



Common application matters

The game icon has been changed.
Added option-sound volume control function.


Operation

 Air scout - At startup, press any key. A message will be added.



Thank you.

notes.title: Update Note. 2021/02/24
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who plays AIRWARS VR in the early access stage.

Today, the game has been improved in various parts, and we are very pleased to announce that.

 Please give us a lot of feedback about our game through the Steam community.


GRAPHIC

Fixed the phenomenon that the aircraft seemed to be shaking
Fixed the part where the water graphic looks awkward
Fixed an issue that the direction of the launched missile and the direction of the smoke effect were different
Fixed a problem where the smoke effect was not properly visible when shooting a missile in Blizzard mission
Fixed the phenomenon that the destroyed aircraft remains at the destroyed location


SOUND

Fixed a problem in which voice lines that should be played in combat situations were not played
Fixed a problem where the briefing dialogue did not play properly when starting the Drug Store B camp
Improved sound when launching missile


OTHER

Fixed a problem that intermittently did not start from the original position when restarting the mission.
Fixed a problem that did not proceed properly even though the mission goal was achieved


Thank you.

notes.title: Update Note. 2020/12/21
notes.content:
First of all, we would like to sincerely thank all of you for playing and talking to AIRWARS VR.
The main thing in this update was to apply the dialogue voice that plays during missions.

We tried to bring more immersion to the mission, which seemed a little flat. So it will provide a different experience than previous one.

Detailed application details are as follows.

General

 Enhance the FPS through water and overall graphics improvements
 Improve the shadow effect
 Adds communication voice generated during mission,
 Improve the sound effect


Mission

 Fix the part that did not progress in certain situations during the mission
 Freedom of airway : Change the camera angle
